narrator_hint: seventh-storyteller / ending routes: several characters; work out the speaker from context

rows.en:
...Beneath this mask lies my heart.
If I take the mask off, it will reach you.
And then you'll surely think I'm a horrible girl......
Just saying it myself has made me sad...{p}

...She turned toward the window.
The morning sun had begun to rise, and bright light streamed in through the window.
The throat peeking out from under her mask glittered, reflecting the light.
"No, you're wrong. Your heart isn't like that.
Maybe right now it's stained with the rage you felt when you were killed, but your true heart is still pure."
I said it almost in a shout.{p}

She lowered her head a little.
And I felt as if she had said 'thank you.'
...Well then, we'll be going back now.
You take care, too.
I was thinking of making you one of us, but I'll let it go.
Your heart is too dazzling for me...{p}

...Goodbye.
She went back into the stall.
Then, still facing away, she took off her mask, held it up high and waved it.
I felt as though the white, expressionless mask smiled a little.
.............
"Goodbye..."
When the six had gone into the stalls too, the doors closed on their own.{p}

Morning sunlight was shining in through the window.
Bathing in that refreshing light, I gazed outside.
The sharp light stung my sleep-deprived eyes, but somehow even that felt good.
It felt as though everything that had been happening until just a moment ago had been a long dream.
I stretched as hard as I could.
"Mmmmh..."{p}

When I hurriedly turned around, that mask was lying in front of the stall.
I picked it up.
...It was the same white, expressionless mask as when I first saw it.
I looked at the stall door once more, but I could no longer feel anything from it.{p}
Still holding the mask, I left the restroom.{p}

But the truth is, you got scared, didn't you?
When you heard you might regret it.
I can tell, you know. I know how you feel.{p}With courage like that, do you really think you could save a girl when it counts?
Yes, I think I could
No, I don't think I could
Don't answer

I see.
That strikes me as a serious delusion, though...
After all, you couldn't save Tomoharu Hosoda, could you?
Or could you have saved someone if it were a girl instead of a boy?
Very well.
I'll test you.
To see whether you can save a girl when it counts.
...With that, she called Iwashita and Fukuzawa forward.
"If it were up to you, which girl would you like to try saving?"{p}
returns: 45:aea0/45:b47c: RETURN - tonda kanchigai rendered 'a serious delusion'; 'you're sorely mistaken' may suit the voice better.

rows.en:
"You seem to understand yourself well.
But isn't it sad?
Thinking of yourself that way.
Or are you the type who enjoys tormenting yourself with thoughts like that?
...You did a fine job as the six's guide.
But that role is over now.
At least you got to have a precious experience before you die.
If I'd taken a liking to you, I was going to stay with you, but it seems you weren't worth that much.
Well then, goodbye."{p}

"Wha..."
The scenery around me wavered for an instant, and then everything was swallowed by darkness.
(Where am I★)
I looked around and was shocked.
Below me, I could see the streetlights of the town.
Before I knew it, I was up in the sky!
I was falling at a tremendous speed.
The streetlights that had spread out below me now spread out above my head.
I was falling headfirst.
(Am I going to die?
Why?
No, I don't want to die yet☆){p}
Faced with the terror of death, I felt my consciousness slip away.{p}

"You have a poor memory, don't you.
Didn't I just tell you I know what you're thinking?{p}You were thinking...
That I could save a girl
That I couldn't save a girl

You seem to think you could save one.
That strikes me as a serious delusion, though...
After all, you couldn't save Tomoharu Hosoda, could you?
Or could you have saved someone if it were a girl instead of a boy?
Very well.
I'll test you.
To see whether you can save a girl when it counts.
...With that, she called Iwashita and Fukuzawa forward.{p}"If it were up to you, which girl would you like to try saving?"
returns: 45:aea0/45:b47c: RETURN - tonda kanchigai rendered 'a serious delusion'; 'you're sorely mistaken' may suit the voice better.

rows.en: Iwashita
Fukuzawa
I don't want either one

So you're not just indecisive, you're plain selfish.
In that case, let's do this.
Suppose I were a woman of unrivaled beauty...
With that, she took off her mask without the slightest hesitation.{p}

The face beneath it...
It was a face of a beauty beyond words.
For a while, I could only stare at it, entranced.
...So this is the kind of face you like.
Too bad, but your face isn't my type.
Then again, you can't tell what a person is really like from the outside alone.{p}
She kept guessing every single thought in my head, which made her really hard to deal with.{p}

(Wh-what is this place?)
An unfamiliar classroom... but somehow it looked like somewhere I'd seen before...
I've got it, this is the old school building.
But unlike the old school building I knew, it felt somewhat newer.
Is this the world as seen through the mask?
Besides me, several students were studying.
"Hey, don't you think the teacher forgot about us?"
One of the students brought it up.
"No way..."
"Nah, it could happen."
(Wh-what is this★
This is that make-up class story she was telling me about!
One, two, three, four... sure enough, there are seven other students besides me!
And the students here all look like the six who gathered to tell the scary stories.
Except that the masked girl is mixed in with them)
"Hey, {a}, you think so too, right?"
"Yeah, you're right.
The teachers must have forgotten all about us."
(Wh-what★ The words are coming out on their own!)
When I was acting normally, I could move my body freely, but at the crucial moments, my body moved on its own.
(Is this a hallucination? Why am I in a place like this?){p}

"Man, this really ticks me off...
Hey, look, there's someone still studying in a situation like this."
A guy who looked like Shindo turned his attack on the masked girl.
(Is this guy Shindo's father...?)
"If you love studying that much, you should've studied before the test."
"It's like she's doing it just to rub it in our faces."
Everyone started badmouthing her.
She stayed silent, staring at her desk.
"You, come here a minute. We need to talk."{p}

Saying that, she took the masked girl to the restroom.
Everyone else went along too.
My body followed along too, on its own.
(...Isn't this the third-floor girls' restroom?)
"Listen, you're just panicking because you got a failing grade for the first time, aren't you?"
"Yeah, we get one every single time."
"...Not that it's anything to brag about."
"Anyway, I'd like you to stop throwing off our study pace.
With you around, it just makes us look like we're slacking off."
With that, everyone surrounded her and shoved her again and again.
(No, we can't do this. She hasn't done anything wrong.
...It's no good, my body won't listen to me)
I was shoving her right along with them.
"Let's lock her in the restroom and go home."
Someone said it in a low voice.
Low as it was, she must have heard it.
Even so, she kept her eyes down and said nothing.
"Ooh, nice. Sounds fun..."{p}

No, I have to stop this.
But my body won't obey me.{p}What do I do...?
Try to stop them somehow
Watch how it plays out

It's no use.
No matter what I do, my body won't obey me.
Tears were welling up in her eyes.
What do I do...?{p}

She pressed her lips tightly together, desperately holding back her tears.
What do I do...?{p}

It's no use.
No matter what I do, my body won't obey me.
Big tears spilled from her eyes.
I summoned every ounce of strength I had and tried to force my disobedient body to move.
(It's no good, it won't move...
She's crying, isn't she? Am I going to let that tragedy happen all over again?
I'm so powerless.
Even being right here, there's nothing at all I can do for her...
Why can't I save her...?
Am I really just afraid?
Don't I think that if I stand up for her, I'll be the one bullied next?
Say my body did move the way I wanted... would I even try to save her then?
Aren't I just hiding behind this body that won't move?
...Maybe that's it.
The truth is, I don't have the courage to save her.
That's why I can't save her.
I'm a coward.
A hopeless coward.
Just a spineless wimp who's scared of being shunned by everyone.
Everybody feels that way, I'm sure.
Nobody wants to be left out.
I'm one of them too.
...Then what about her?
She must hate being left out too.
And I'm the one trying to leave her out.
No, this is wrong, this is all wrong!)
Suddenly my body felt lighter.
(I can move! I can move!){p}

"Hey, let's stop.
Doing this won't get us anywhere.
What's locking her up supposed to accomplish?"
Everyone was staring at me.
"...Hey, what's your deal, {a}?
Don't go killing the mood all of a sudden."
"What good is doing this?
She hasn't done anything wrong.
Don't you feel sorry for her?"
I pleaded desperately.
Even so, Shindo wouldn't listen.
"It doesn't have to do any good.
As long as we're having fun right now, that's all that matters.
...Great, now you've killed the mood.
Hey, don't tell me you like her.
You're covering for her 'cause you like her, right?"
Everyone started grinning.
(Here it comes. I can pretty much guess what these guys are thinking.
Whenever they find something new to tease about, they jump right on it)
"She's our classmate, so of course I would.
We're friends, so it's wrong to bully her."
"Ha... You're no fun at all, you know that?
Let's go home. The mood's dead.
...Hey, {a}.
You'd better remember this."
With that, the six went home.{p}
The mask slid off my face.{p}

I picked it up and looked at it.
It was just a white mask, made of something like plastic.
Looking at it, I thought.
Maybe I could only stand up for her because it wasn't reality, but a virtual world.
Hadn't I just put on a mask and played a different version of myself?
The guy who looked like Shindo had told me:
'{a}, you'd better remember this.'
But I knew there was no tomorrow in that world.
I knew my turn would never come around.
That's exactly why I could stand up for her back then.
And what if it had been the real world?
I surely wouldn't have been able to save her.
Had she truly been saved by this?{p}

Morning sunlight came streaming in through the window.
I walked out of the restroom alone.{p}
It's no use, there's nothing I can do.{p}

"All right, let's do it right now."
I was saying things I didn't mean.
"Go on, get in. Come on, hurry up."

We shoved her into the stall.
Then we wedged a bar against the door so it couldn't be opened from inside.

"Let me out, let me out! Please... let me out of here!"
From inside came a tearful, heartrending plea.
"Heh, serves her right."
With that, we left the restroom.
We didn't forget to turn off the restroom light, either.{p}

The restroom went pitch-black.
From inside, I could hear her sobbing quietly.
(It's no good, I couldn't save her.
But it can't be helped. My body won't listen to me.
If I'd had control of my body, I'm sure I could have saved her...)
Just then, I heard a voice from somewhere.
"{a}. In the end, you couldn't save me after all, could you?
Fine. You will spend the rest of your life there.
And your child will be the one I take my revenge on..."{p}

It felt like a flash of light shot through my head.
(Huh, I thought I just heard something inside my head...
Was it just my imagination...?)
"Man, the teacher's so awful.
Going home and forgetting all about us."
"What a mess we got into."
We walked down the now completely dark hallway toward the classroom.
(I'm beat today. A lot happened.
I'll go to bed early tonight...){p}

You were thinking you couldn't save a girl, weren't you?
Is that why you couldn't answer?
You really are a coward.
...You did a fine job as the six's guide.
But that role is over now.
At least you got to have a precious experience before you die.
If I'd taken a liking to you, I was going to stay with you, but it seems you weren't worth that much.
Well then, goodbye.{p}

"Wha..."
The scenery around me wavered for an instant, and then everything was swallowed by darkness.
(Where am I★)
I looked around and was shocked.
Below me, I could see the streetlights of the town.
Before I knew it, I was up in the sky!
I was falling at a tremendous speed.
The streetlights that had spread out below me now spread out above my head.
I was falling headfirst.
(Am I going to die?
Why?
No, I don't want to die yet☆){p}
Faced with the terror of death, I felt my consciousness slip away.{p}

I chose Iwashita.
Maybe, partly because of what happened with Uchiyama, I felt guilty.
"So, you choose her."
When I looked at Iwashita, she was smiling sweetly.
Fukuzawa, standing beside her, didn't look very happy.{p}

"But why Iwashita, of all people?
Iwashita tried to kill you, you know.
And you'll still take up the challenge.
...Now I understand. How kind you are.
If I touch a heart like that, maybe even I could pass on."
With that, the masked woman walked toward me.
And she and I overlapped.{p}

...Leaving behind only the white mask.
I picked up the mask and stared at it.
Had she been saved?
Had my kindness let her pass on?
I didn't know, but I felt really good.{p}

Morning sunlight came streaming in from outside the window.
(It's already morning...){p}

I started to leave the restroom.
"Wait, {a}."
I turned around.
"Ah..."{p}

Fukuzawa was standing there.
"Fukuzawa..."
"{a}. Give me back the mask.
I won't forget, you know. That you didn't choose me, {a}.
I was so sure that you, {a}, would choose me.
It's a shame...
From today on, I'm taking over that mask.
And I'll make this restroom my home.
...The old school building will be torn down soon.
When that happens, I'll move. Over to the new school building.
And someday, I'll call you over to my place too.{p}

With that, she took the mask from me and went into the stall.
..................
The restroom rumors had not come to an end.
Had yet another new Hanako-san been brought into the world?
Anyway, my job was done.
All that was left was to write it up as an article.
The moment I thought that, I was hit by overwhelming drowsiness.{p}
Rubbing my sleepy eyes, I staggered out through the school gate.

(Huh, I hear some kind of huge noise...)
(F-Fukuzawa... has she come for me already...? That's way too soon...){p}

"I see. So it's Fukuzawa.
You abandoned Fukuzawa once, didn't you?
And you still want to try saving her?"
The masked woman said.
"That's not true!
I never abandoned Fukuzawa.
I couldn't have predicted that would happen.
It all happened so fast, there was no way I could save her!"
"Exactly.
But can you ever predict when the moment that counts will come?"
"Ngh..."
I couldn't say anything back.
...I'd thought that you, of all people, might be able to save my heart...
But it seems I can't expect that.
She heaved a big sigh beneath the mask.
Then she took off her mask.{p}

They vanished like smoke.
...Leaving behind only the white mask.{p}

I picked up the mask.
And the moment I turned to leave the restroom...{p}

The mask exploded.
With tremendous force.
Without even a moment to think about what had happened, I was blown to pieces.
I watched the scene from up near the ceiling.
When I looked behind me, the girl wearing the mask was beckoning to me.
Behind her stood the six, smiling brightly.{p}

"I'd like Kazama, please..."
I'd gone and answered a question like that.
I must have lost my mind.
And on top of that, I'd picked Kazama, of all people.{p}

"So you want me to kill you. Good, good, aren't you a cute one.
I'll kill you with the most fun way to die there is.{p}Can you guess what it is?"
Death by dancing
Death by singing
Death by sleeping

"Bzzt! The correct answer was number four, 'death by laughing'!"
(...This guy's infuriating right up to the very end)
"Now, I'll let you hear my greatest gag ever.
It's a terrifying one that makes you laugh until you die.
Are you ready?"
With that, Kazama whispered into my ear.{p}

".........Pfft... Ahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!"
I burst out laughing so hard my sides nearly split.
What was so funny about a gag like that?
But I couldn't stop laughing.
It was humiliating.
To think I'd laugh at a gag like that.
I laughed so hard my diaphragm started to ache.
Tears streamed endlessly from my eyes.
I-I can't... breathe...
I was laughing so violently I couldn't breathe, and it grew more and more painful.
Drool dribbled sloppily from my mouth.
I tried to draw a breath, but it wouldn't come.
"...Hee... hee-hee..."
He said I'd die having fun, but... it... hurts... so...{p}

The color drained from my face, little by little.
"Kh... kah........."{p}
I died.{p}

What a pathetic way to die.
If I had to die anyway, I wish I could have died a more decent death.
They'll probably find it tomorrow. My corpse...
A male student, dead in front of the restroom, clutching his stomach.
And then the doctor will say,
"...The cause of death is laughter. ...He laughed himself to death..."
H-how pathetic...{p}

"Well, well, so you want me to kill you..."
Arai said, his lips stretching into a slow grin.
Damn it.
Why on earth did I pick someone like him?{p}

"Very well. There's something I've wanted to try at least once myself, you see."
With that, Arai asked everyone to hold me down.
"The truth is, I heard about it somewhere once before.
Oh, if you're asking what, it's nothing much, really.
It's a story that if you stab a straw into someone's body, blood spurts out through the straw and they die..."
Arai took out a straw and stroked it, smirking.
"My, I never thought I'd actually get the chance to try it."
With that, Arai drove the straw into my thigh.{p}

A fierce pain shot through my thigh.
Why would a mere straw pierce my leg...?
That stupid thought flashed through my mind.
The answer was simple.
That straw was made of iron. It was less a straw than an iron tube.{p}

"Well, how boring.
I was sure the blood would come spurting out, but it's only dripping..."
Saying that, Arai drove a straw into my other leg as well.
"No good. It still won't spurt. I suppose it would if I stuck it into an artery..."{p}

As he spoke, he kept stabbing straw after straw into me.
Blood dripped endlessly from their ends, drip, drip, without stopping.
Maybe because of all the blood drained out of me, my mind was growing hazy.
Each time Arai stabbed in another straw, the pain cleared my head, but it soon clouded over again.
And then I stopped feeling even the pain.
(I'm so sleepy...)
A crushing drowsiness came over me.
(How good it would feel to just fall asleep like this...){p}

I gently closed my eyes.
And I fell into eternal sleep...{p}

"Me, huh? {a}, you've got some real guts. Picking me of all people."
Shindo said it with a pleased look.{p}

"If I lay a hand on you, killing you'd be easy.
But that wouldn't be any fun, would it?
............
{a}, you don't wanna die, right?
Yeah, figured.
There's no reason at all for you to die.
So here's the deal. I'll give you a chance.
Go ahead and run. As far as you want.
I'll be coming after you.
If I catch you, don't say I didn't warn you.
That'll be when you die."
With that, Shindo let go of me.
"Hurry up and run.
In one minute, I'm coming after you.
Run wherever you like.{p}

But don't think you can get away from me that easy.
I'll follow you anywhere.
Even to the ends of the universe..."
Shindo grinned.{p}

I shot off like a spring.
(I'll get away! This is the chance I finally got.
I'm going to escape no matter what!)
I ran all the way to the school gate.
A minute must have passed long ago.
I looked back over my shoulder.{p}

"☆"
Shindo was running after me.
About fifty meters behind.
He was moving at an unbelievable speed.{p}

When I looked back, he was still following about fifty meters behind me, same as ever.
With a pickaxe in his hand.
(S-something's wrong. The gap has stayed about this size the whole time.
Maybe this gap will never change at all.){p}

I tried stopping.
(No good! If I stop, the gap closes!)
I could never stop again, not ever.
It seemed that unless I kept up a certain speed, the gap between Shindo and me would shrink.
"Hah... hah... hah..."{p}

(My side hurts...)
This was the first time I'd ever run this much.
I'd already run all the way to the next town.
(If it hurts this much, I'd be better off dead...){p}

I even thought about steeling myself to stop and letting Shindo kill me.
But I couldn't bring myself to do it.
My legs kept carrying me forward on their own.
There must still be some part of me, somewhere, that didn't want to die.{p}
"My heart..."{p}

"☆☆"
(My heart...){p}

My heart hurt as if it were being crushed in a vise.
At last, I collapsed.
I couldn't move another step. I couldn't even stand up...
When I looked back, Shindo was already almost upon me.{p}
Thump... thump...... thu... thump.{p}

My heartbeat was wrong.
Shindo was right in front of me now.{p}
Thump......{p}
Shindo was raising the pickaxe high.{p}

My heart stopped.
(M-my mind is...)
My consciousness was slipping away.
The pickaxe swinging down at me filled my eyes.
(............){p}

"Whaaat? You want me to kill you?"
Fukuzawa seemed surprised that she'd been chosen.
"What should I do...
............
Oh, I know! How about I cut off some of your flesh, {a}, and make you eat it?"
Wh-what a horrible idea.
With a face that cute, how could she think up something like that?
This is exactly why you can't trust girls.
"Look, there's even a kitchen knife right here..."
Fukuzawa produced a kitchen knife from somewhere.
"So, where should I start?
{a}, which part of you would you like to eat?"{p}

(What does it matter where she starts?
Oh, I know. I'll say the meat of my neck.
That way, I can die the moment she cuts into my neck.
At least then I might not have to suffer.)
"Fukuzawa, I want to eat the meat of my neck. Please start there."
I tried asking her.
"Whaaat, the neck?
But that's no fun at all.
If you eat from a place like that, you'll die right away!"
She saw right through me...
I was so crushed with despair I nearly fainted.{p}

"Let's see... How about some thigh meat?
Doesn't that look pretty tasty?"
With that, Shindo and the others around us pinned my legs down.
My pants were slashed open.
"My, doesn't that look delicious..."
Fukuzawa stroked my leg, looking utterly delighted.
I couldn't stop shaking.
"Okay, here I go..."{p}
"Gyaaaaaaaaahhh!"{p}

A sharp pain shot through my thigh.
I felt like I'd pass out any second.{p}

"See, I got it off. Well? Looks yummy, doesn't it?"
Fukuzawa held the meat of my thigh in one hand, smiling sweetly.{p}

Lukewarm blood spread through my mouth.
No matter how hard I tried not to swallow, it slid down into my stomach on its own.{p}

"Come on, you gotta chew it properly."
Shindo grabbed my jaw and forcibly worked it up and down.{p}

Squelch... squelch...
A raw, fishy stench spread through my mouth.
"Gh... hurk..."
I felt so sick I nearly threw up.{p}

(Why do I have to go through this?
All because I took on this project...
Help... somebody help me...)
Maybe from losing so much blood, my vision began to blur.
I could see Fukuzawa's face, gleeful, as she fed me the meat.{p}

That was the last sight I ever saw.
The next day, I was found with the flesh cut from every part of my body and stuffed into my mouth.{p}
"B-by Hosoda..."{p}

"Huh? You really want me?"
Hosoda's face broke into a truly happy smile.
(Damn it, why did I pick this guy?
A bad feeling ran through me.)
"I'm so happy, I really am..."
Hosoda threw his arms around me as I lay on the floor.{p}

(Well, I'm not happy...
...Ugh, h-heavy......)
Even though he was a ghost, I could feel his weight.
Hosoda climbed completely on top of me.{p}

"Guh... gehh..."
"I'm so happy... I'm so happy..."
Hosoda bounced his body up and down on top of me.
Each time, his weight, which had to be well over a hundred kilos, came crashing down on me.{p}

Hosoda's face was so close our noses were almost touching.
"Ah, {a}. Your breath really stinks, you know..."
Hosoda said that to me while breathing his own foul breath on me.
I wanted to say "Look who's talking," but I couldn't get a sound out.{p}

Gradually, even breathing became painful.
(Am I going to die crushed by Hosoda...?)
Who could ever have imagined dying like this?
If I had to die like this, I thought, I'd rather have died with my throat slit.
But it's too late now...{p}
Somewhere, I thought I heard a wet squelch.{p}

"Thank you.
I think so too.
Now I can finally go to the place I was always meant to go.
Goodbye, then, {a}."
The morning sun shone in through the window.
She was wrapped in its light.{p}

Then she vanished, as if swallowed up by that light.
Where she had stood, the mask she'd been wearing lay where it had been gently set down.{p}
returns: 45:110f4: RETURN - 'lay where it had been gently set down' is accurate but clunky; editorial may smooth

rows.en:
I looked out the window.
The long night was over, and a soft light enveloped everything.
"Mmmmm..."
I gave a big stretch.
Somehow, I felt like I could write a good article.
But how would I explain the disappearance of the people who had told me scary stories?
...There was no need to think about it.
All I could do was write honestly about what I'd been through.
After all, it's something even I can't explain.{p}
I picked up the mask and walked out of the restroom.{p}

I shook off that hand.
Like hell I'd let them take me.
There were still so many things I wanted to do.
Besides, there was no reason at all for me to be taken.{p}

(...It can't be helped. Sooner or later, you will become one of us.
That is your fate. That is the fate laid upon you.
You cannot escape it...
That is why I'm telling you to come with us...{p}

Very well. Then I'll go on ahead. I'll be looking forward to it, so come soon.
Heh heh heh heh heh...){p}
Iwashita and the others simply went away.{p}

(My fate...)
Blood kept flowing endlessly from my leg.
(Maybe it is. At this rate, I'm going to die...)
The blood pouring out of me had dyed my uniform bright red.{p}

(No, I can't lose heart. I'm going to make it home alive.)
Dragging my leg, I started walking toward the outside.
Everything in front of me looked doubled, tripled, blurring.
(Just a little more... just a little more and I'll be outside...){p}

A gentle light was shining in through the window of the exit door.
